description: Grid promotion of the Whipple toroidal degree<->order constant from one-point numerical discovery to a symbolic-exact structural identity: reproduces a-independence at >=3 (nu,mu) points, grid-verifies BOTH Gamma-shift laws across 8 generic non-special (nu,mu) points, derives the closed form c(nu,mu)=sqrt(2/pi)*e^{-i*pi*nu}/Gamma(nu+mu+1/2) implied by the two recurrences, and tests it against the direct 60-dps compute on a 10-point grid (~1e-40).
discipline: no fit; mpmath 60 dps compute, 40 sig digits serialized as strings; closed form DERIVED from the two shift recurrences then tested (not fitted); tiered verdict; (a)-scoped; identification stays a lead.
verdict: SYMBOLIC-EXACT STRUCTURAL IDENTITY (GRID-VERIFIED, NOT ONE-POINT). The a-independent Whipple toroidal constant c(nu,mu) := P^{-mu}_{nu-1/2}(coth a) / (sqrt(sinh a) * Q^{nu}_{mu-1/2}(cosh a)) has closed form c(nu,mu) = sqrt(2/pi) * exp(-i*pi*nu) / Gamma(nu+mu+1/2). Both Gamma-shift laws c(nu,mu+1)/c(nu,mu)=+1/(nu+mu+1/2) and c(nu+1,mu)/c(nu,mu)=-1/(nu+mu+1/2) hold to ~1e-40 across a grid of 8 generic (nu,mu) points (non-integer AND non-half-integer); solving the two first-order recurrences forces c = C*e^{-i*pi*nu}/Gamma(nu+mu+1/2), and the (nu,mu)-independent constant is grid-identified as C = sqrt(2/pi) (imaginary part numerically zero). The derived closed form matches the direct 60-dps compute to ~1e-40 on a 10-point extended grid. SCOPE: this promotes assertion (5) of whipple_rotation_involution_probe from one-point discovery to a grid-verified exact identity for the CONSTANT; the full rotation_step <-> Whipple IDENTIFICATION (audit S9, conjecture class WhippleRotationIntertwining) stays an OPEN LEAD — proving the constant's Gamma-structure does NOT prove the categorical identification. Nothing here wires to production or touches an observable.
